title: 5 Trends for 2018
notes: TrendWatching Quarterly, November 2017 issue (first archived 2017-11-09). Labels are the section headings, in print order. The full 2018 Trend Report (Premium, released 2017-11-21) is not captured. target_year 2018 from the title.

entries.label: A-COMMERCE
entries.quote: Because in 2018, shoppers with more important things to do – and that’s all of them – will embrace the outsourcing of certain retail experiences to algorithms and smart devices.
entries.subject: Automated, algorithm-led shopping

entries.label: ASSISTED DEVELOPMENT
entries.quote: Post-demographic consumers – of all ages! – are crafting new narratives of adulthood. In 2018, they’ll look to brands to help.
entries.subject: Brands helping consumers reach adult life goals ('adulting')

entries.label: VIRTUAL COMPANIONS
entries.quote: Because this is the year that millions of consumers start to feel it is possible to have a meaningful conversation (💖 a relationship, even 💖) with virtual entities that entertain, educate, heal and even befriend.
entries.subject: AI chatbots and virtual entities as companions
entries.note: Dek: 'Virtual entities make the leap from assistants to companions.' Section cites Gartner's prediction that by 2020 the average person will have more conversations with bots than with their spouse; Gartner's claim, not recorded as metric. Emoji kept as printed.

entries.label: FORGIVING BY DESIGN
entries.quote: In 2018 they’ll expect all kinds of products and services to forgive them when their past – the product they selected, the size they chose, the service they wanted – doesn't match their future.
entries.subject: Products and services that adapt after purchase

entries.label: GLASS BOX WRECKING BALLS
entries.quote: What kind of transparency WRECKING BALL is heading your way in 2018?
entries.subject: Transparency exposing internal company culture (#MeToo)
entries.note: Dek: 'A revolution in transparency is just getting started.' Framed as a question; the trend claim is that radical transparency will expose internal cultures.
